name: Beijing
tagline: Imperial stories, lived one hutong at a time.
description: The scale is imperial, but the memorable moments are often small: breakfast at a neighbourhood stall, a turn into a quiet hutong, the first glimpse of a courtyard roof. Give Beijing enough days to move between its monumental history and everyday life without rushing.

highlights.name: Forbidden City
highlights.description: Give the palace a full morning and leave time for the galleries, not just the central axis.

highlights.name: Temple of Heaven
highlights.description: Walk through the park before exploring the ceremonial architecture.

highlights.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
highlights.description: Make this a separate day trip, with transport back to the city arranged in advance.

food: Peking duck · jianbing · sesame noodles
tip: Book major sights through their official channels. Beijing is spread out: group each day around one part of the city.

name: Shanghai
tagline: Old lanes, new horizons, and one remarkable river.
description: Shanghai rewards walking. Start with the grand riverfront, then turn towards leafy residential streets, small cafés and the everyday rhythms of the old lanes. Its pleasure lies in the contrast between a constantly changing skyline and details you only notice at street level.

highlights.name: The Bund
highlights.description: Walk the historic waterfront and return after dusk for a different view.

highlights.name: Former French Concession

highlights.name: Shanghai Museum
highlights.description: Choose a museum branch and check the exhibitions before setting aside a half-day.

food: Xiaolongbao · scallion-oil noodles · shengjianbao
tip: Choose accommodation near a metro station. The two airports are far apart: check SHA versus PVG carefully.

name: Guilin
tagline: Let the river set the pace.
description: The landscape is the reason to come, but slowing down is what makes it memorable. Limestone peaks rise above rivers, villages and fields. Spend part of the journey around Yangshuo, with enough time to enjoy rural paths between the famous viewpoints.

highlights.name: Li River
highlights.description: Choose a river excursion for limestone peaks and changing reflections.

highlights.name: Yulong River
highlights.description: Base yourself in Yangshuo for quiet rural lanes and river scenery.

highlights.name: Xingping
highlights.description: Spend time along the riverside and explore beyond the busiest photo stop.

food: Guilin rice noodles · stuffed vegetables · beer fish
tip: Guilin and Yangshuo are different bases. Check exactly where your train arrives and where your river trip starts.

name: Chengdu
wiki: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
tagline: Good food. Long tea breaks. No need to rush.
description: This is a city that makes room for a long lunch and an even longer cup of tea. Pandas may bring you here, but parks, neighbourhood cooking and the rhythm of daily life are reasons to stay. A flexible afternoon can be as rewarding as a booked attraction.

highlights.name: Panda Research Base

highlights.name: People’s Park
